rules.title: RPC provider win-rate below 95% in a region

annotations.summary: No provider is clearly winning region {{ $labels.region }} for getLatestBlockhash
annotations.description: The leading provider's win-rate in region {{ $labels.region }} has dropped below 95% (currently {{ printf "%.1f" $values.B.Value }}%). Provider average latencies have converged, indicating a regression for the previously dominant provider or a regional issue. Inspect the 'Win % by provider per region' dashboard panel.

model.expr: 100 * max by (region) ( avg_over_time( ( (sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_latency_seconds_sum{method="getLatestBlockhash"}[5m])) / sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_latency_seconds_count{method="getLatestBlockhash"}[5m]))) == bool on (region) group_left() (min by (region) (sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_latency_seconds_sum{method="getLatestBlockhash"}[5m])) / sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_latency_seconds_count{method="getLatestBlockhash"}[5m])))) )[1h:1m] ) )
